text: The quiet isn't empty. It's heavy. It presses against the walls until the room feels too small to breathe in.
I tried to burn the bridges, but the sparks just caught the dry grass. Now everything is burning, and I'm still on the wrong side.
It wasn't a voice, but a pull. A sudden, terrifying clarity that staying still was the only true failure.
Waiting for an answer that was never promised.
The hardest part isn't the fall, it's the sudden stop. The sudden realization that the safety net was just a shadow.
I heard it in the static. A rhythm beneath the noise. It told me to wake up.
